description: `activity send --ask` records an open ask in the recipient's own log, visible as an `ASK #<seq>` inbox line; `activity reply SEQ MESSAGE` resolves that open ask by its seq in the recipient's own log and sends the reply back into the original asker's log (`may_send_reverse` from `[activity.pairs]`); a second, unrelated ask is instead resolved with no reply via `activity close SEQ --reason ...` (local close prints `closed #<seq>.` and tells the asker why). `activity update CARD --phase --note` posts onto a dispatched card in the caller's own log, with a second post inside the default cooldown window suppressed instead of duplicated.

expect.stdout:
replied to sandbox as seq 2
  inbox still has unacked mail; run `multiverse activity inbox`.

sent to sandbox2.
  inbox still has unacked mail; run `multiverse activity inbox`.

closed #3.
told the asker why.
  inbox still has unacked mail; run `multiverse activity inbox`.
